Aggr_SR <- function(cellchat_list, eval){
  all_result <- lapply(cellchat_list, function(cellchat){
    counts <- cellchat@net[[eval]]
    
    counts <- reshape2::melt(counts)
    colnames(counts) <- c('Sender', 'Receiver', 'Value')
    counts$Sender <- as.character(counts$Sender)
    counts$Receiver <- as.character(counts$Receiver)
    
    counts$Sender[grepl('^ly|^my|^B|^Plasma|^Mast', counts$Sender)] <- 'Immune'
    counts$Receiver[grepl('^ly|^my|^B|^Plasma|^Mast', counts$Receiver)] <- 'Immune'
    
    result <- aggregate(Value ~ Sender + Receiver, data = counts, sum)
    result
  })
}

interactions_num <- Aggr_SR(cellchat_list, 'count')
interactions_strength <- Aggr_SR(cellchat_list, 'weight')

Aggr_SorR <- function(interactions, type){
  temp <- lapply(interactions, function(depot_temp){
    
    if(type=='Sender'){
      result <- aggregate(Value ~ Sender, data = depot_temp, sum)
    }else if(type=='Receiver'){
      result <- aggregate(Value ~ Receiver, data = depot_temp, sum)
    }
    
    result
  }) %>% do.call(rbind, .)
  temp <- tibble::rownames_to_column(temp, 'depot')
  temp$depot <- sub('\\.[0-9]+', '', temp$depot)
  colnames(temp)[2] <- 'Celltype'
  temp$Type <- type
  temp
}

receiver_num <- Aggr_SorR(interactions_num, 'Receiver')

cellchat_list <- object.list

pathways_list <- lapply(cellchat_list, function(cellchat){
  pathways_prob <- cellchat@netP$prob
  
  pathways_prob_df <- lapply(cellchat@netP$pathways, function(pathway){
    df_pathway <- pathways_prob[, ,pathway]
    df_pathway <- reshape2::melt(df_pathway)
    colnames(df_pathway) <- c('Sender', 'Receiver', 'Value')
    df_pathway$Sender <- as.character(df_pathway$Sender)
    df_pathway$Receiver <- as.character(df_pathway$Receiver)
    
    df_pathway$Sender[grepl('^ly|^my|^B|^Plasma|^Mast', df_pathway$Sender)] <- 'Immune'
    df_pathway$Sender[grepl('^Adipo', df_pathway$Sender)] <- 'Adipocyte'
    df_pathway$Sender[grepl('^vC', df_pathway$Sender)] <- 'Vascular'
    df_pathway$Sender[which(df_pathway$Sender %in% c('famC01', 'famC04', 'famC06', 'famC10'))] <- 'Mesothelial'
    df_pathway$Sender[grepl('^famC', df_pathway$Sender)] <- 'FAP'
    
    df_pathway$Receiver[grepl('^ly|^my|^B|^Plasma|^Mast', df_pathway$Receiver)] <- 'Immune'
    df_pathway$Receiver[grepl('^Adipo', df_pathway$Receiver)] <- 'Adipocyte'
    df_pathway$Receiver[grepl('^vC', df_pathway$Receiver)] <- 'Vascular'
    df_pathway$Receiver[which(df_pathway$Receiver %in% c('famC01', 'famC04', 'famC06', 'famC10'))] <- 'Mesothelial'
    df_pathway$Receiver[grepl('^famC', df_pathway$Receiver)] <- 'FAP'
    
    df_pathway <- aggregate(Value ~ Sender + Receiver, data = df_pathway, sum)
    df_pathway$Pathway <- pathway
    df_pathway
  })
  pathways_prob_df <- do.call(rbind, pathways_prob_df) %>% as.data.frame()
  pathways_prob_df
})

pathways_df <- do.call(rbind, pathways_list) %>% as.data.frame()

pathways_df$depot <- sub('\\.[0-9]+', '', pathways_df$depot)
pathways_df <- aggregate(Value ~ depot + Pathway, data = pathways_df, sum)

pathways_df$depot <- factor(pathways_df$depot, levels = c("sc","om","ms","mc","ep"))


temp <- dcast(pathways_df, Pathway ~ depot, value.var = "Value")


pathways_df_combine <- pathways_df %>%

temp$Pathway <- factor(temp$Pathway,levels = pathways_df_combine$Pathway)

temp[is.na(temp)] <- 0

pathways_df_ordered <- pathways_df %>%
  inner_join(pathways_df_combine, by = "Pathway") %>%

df_filled <- pathways_df_ordered %>%
  tidyr::complete(depot, Pathway, fill = list(Value = 0)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Value))

  pathways_list <- lapply(cellchat_list, function(cellchat){
    pathways_prob <- cellchat@netP$prob

    pathways_prob_df <- lapply(cellchat@netP$pathways, function(pathway){
      df_pathway <- pathways_prob[, ,pathway]
      df_pathway <- reshape2::melt(df_pathway)
      colnames(df_pathway) <- c('Sender', 'Receiver', 'Value')
      df_pathway$Sender <- as.character(df_pathway$Sender)
      df_pathway$Receiver <- as.character(df_pathway$Receiver)

      df_pathway$Sender[grepl('^ly|^my|^B|^Plasma|^Mast', df_pathway$Sender)] <- 'Immune'
      df_pathway$Sender[grepl('^Adipo', df_pathway$Sender)] <- 'Adipocyte'
      df_pathway$Sender[grepl('^vC', df_pathway$Sender)] <- 'Vascular'
      df_pathway$Sender[which(df_pathway$Sender %in% c('famC01', 'famC04', 'famC06', 'famC10'))] <- 'Mesothelial'
      df_pathway$Sender[grepl('^famC', df_pathway$Sender)] <- 'FAP'

      df_pathway$Receiver[grepl('^ly|^my|^B|^Plasma|^Mast', df_pathway$Receiver)] <- 'Immune'
      df_pathway$Receiver[grepl('^Adipo', df_pathway$Receiver)] <- 'Adipocyte'
      df_pathway$Receiver[grepl('^vC', df_pathway$Receiver)] <- 'Vascular'
      df_pathway$Receiver[which(df_pathway$Receiver %in% c('famC01', 'famC04', 'famC06', 'famC10'))] <- 'Mesothelial'
      df_pathway$Receiver[grepl('^famC', df_pathway$Receiver)] <- 'FAP'

      df_pathway <- aggregate(Value ~ Sender + Receiver, data = df_pathway, sum)
      df_pathway$Pathway <- pathway
      df_pathway
    })
    pathways_prob_df <- do.call(rbind, pathways_prob_df) %>% as.data.frame()
    pathways_prob_df
  })

  pathways_df <- do.call(rbind, pathways_list) %>% as.data.frame()
  pathways_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(pathways_df, 'depot')
  pathways_df$depot <- sub('\\.[0-9]+', '', pathways_df$depot)
  pathways_df <- aggregate(Value ~ depot + Pathway, data = pathways_df, sum)

  pathways_df$depot <- factor(pathways_df$depot,levels = c("sc","om","ms","mc","ep"))

  temp <- dcast(pathways_df, Pathway ~ depot, value.var = "Value")


  pathways_df_combine <- pathways_df %>%
    group_by(Pathway) %>%
    summarise(Total_Value = sum(Value)) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    arrange(desc(Total_Value))

  temp$Pathway <- factor(temp$Pathway,levels = pathways_df_combine$Pathway)
  temp <- temp[order(temp$Pathway),]
  temp[is.na(temp)] <- 0

  pathways_df_ordered <- pathways_df %>%
    inner_join(pathways_df_combine, by = "Pathway") %>%
    arrange(match(Pathway, pathways_df_combine$Pathway))

  df_filled <- pathways_df_ordered %>%
    tidyr::complete(depot, Pathway, fill = list(Value = 0)) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    arrange(desc(Total_Value))

  df_filled$sample <- sample

  df_all <- rbind(df_all, df_filled)

}
